verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.170
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.170

verses.pali: 17. Āghātavagga
verses.english: 17. Resentment

verses.pali: Bhaddajisutta
verses.english: With Bhaddaji

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Ānanda was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā bhaddaji yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then Venerable Bhaddaji went up to Venerable Ānanda, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ bhaddajiṁ āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side, and Venerable Ānanda said to him:

verses.pali: “kiṁ nu kho, āvuso bhaddaji, dassanānaṁ aggaṁ, kiṁ savanānaṁ aggaṁ, kiṁ sukhānaṁ aggaṁ, kiṁ saññānaṁ aggaṁ, kiṁ bhavānaṁ aggan”ti?
verses.english: “Reverend Bhaddaji, what is the best sight, the best sound, the best happiness, the best perception, and the best state of existence?”

verses.pali: “Atthāvuso, brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī, yo taṁ brahmānaṁ passati, idaṁ dassanānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend, there is this Divinity, the vanquisher, the unvanquished, the universal seer, the wielder of power. When you see the Divinity, that’s the best sight.

verses.pali: Atthāvuso, ābhassarā nāma devā sukhena abhisannā parisannā.
verses.english: There are the gods called ‘of streaming radiance’, who are drenched and steeped in pleasure.

verses.pali: Te kadāci karahaci udānaṁ udānenti:
verses.english: Every so often they feel inspired to exclaim:

verses.pali: ‘aho sukhaṁ, aho sukhan’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, what bliss! Oh, what bliss!’

verses.pali: Yo taṁ saddaṁ suṇāti, idaṁ savanānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: When you hear that, it’s the best sound.

verses.pali: Atthāvuso, subhakiṇhā nāma devā.
verses.english: There are the gods called ‘of universal beauty’.

verses.pali: Te santaṁyeva tusitā sukhaṁ paṭivedenti, idaṁ sukhānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: Since they’re truly content, they experience pleasure. This is the best happiness.

verses.pali: Atthāvuso, ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṁ saññānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: There are the gods reborn in the dimension of nothingness. This is the best perception.

verses.pali: Atthāvuso, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṁ bhavānaṁ aggan”ti.
verses.english: There are the gods reborn in the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception. This is the best state of existence.”

verses.pali: “Sameti kho idaṁ āyasmato bhaddajissa, yadidaṁ bahunā janenā”ti?
verses.english: “So, Venerable Bhaddaji, do you agree with what most people say about this?”

verses.pali: “Āyasmā kho ānando bahussuto.
verses.english: “Well, Venerable Ānanda, you’re very learned.

verses.pali: Paṭibhātu āyasmantaṁyeva ānandan”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t you clarify this yourself?”

verses.pali: “Tenahāvuso bhaddaji, suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: “Well then, Reverend Bhaddaji, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā bhaddaji āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
verses.english: “Yes, reverend,” Bhaddaji replied.

verses.pali: Āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
verses.english: Ānanda said this:

verses.pali: “Yathā passato kho, āvuso, anantarā āsavānaṁ khayo hoti, idaṁ dassanānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: “What you see when the defilements are ended without delay is the best sight.

verses.pali: Yathā suṇato anantarā āsavānaṁ khayo hoti, idaṁ savanānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: What you hear when the defilements are ended without delay is the best sound.

verses.pali: Yathā sukhitassa anantarā āsavānaṁ khayo hoti, idaṁ sukhānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: The happiness you feel when the defilements are ended without delay is the best happiness.

verses.pali: Yathā saññissa anantarā āsavānaṁ khayo hoti, idaṁ saññānaṁ aggaṁ.
verses.english: What you perceive when the defilements are ended without delay is the best perception.

verses.pali: Yathā bhūtassa anantarā āsavānaṁ khayo hoti, idaṁ bhavānaṁ aggan”ti.
verses.english: The state of existence in which the defilements are ended without delay is the best state of existence.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Āghātavaggo dutiyo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Dve āghātavinayā,
sākacchā sājīvato pañhaṁ;
Pucchā nirodho codanā,
sīlaṁ nisanti bhaddajīti.
